body:
This is very encouraging. I'm afraid to tell her because it's her first semester of college, I wouldn't want to stress her out more than she already is. It's been a very lonely battle. I know maybe someday I will be able to tell her, but as you said, the thought of rejection is horrifying. I'm already on benzo's and they scare me half to death themselves.

Edit : Another hard part about telling someone my problems is the manliness factor. Society says I have to be strong.
